notes.title: Release of Chronicles of cyberpunk - Deep sleep
notes.content:
Hi all. The game Chronicles of cyberpunk - Deep sleep was released after 4.5 years of development and is already available to everyone for free. Immerse yourself in an adventure where you once again have to confront Big Brother and the Supercomputer in a mysterious and unusual world

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31199973/2d321192d405c58347f0442455140b1ee1446f46.jpg[/img]

In the meantime, I'm starting work on the next game - the third and final part of the trilogy. This will be the climax, completing the plot and giving answers to many questions.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1433000/Chronicles_of_cyberpunk__Deep_sleep/

notes.title: New trailer for Chronicles of cyberpunk - Deep sleep
notes.content:
Hi all. After more than 4.5 years of development, the game is almost done and will soon get to the release. So I made a new trailer. The game will be free-to-play and quite short - it can be completed in 2 hours. I didn’t have the goal of artificially stretching it, but I just wanted to fit all my ideas, combine them with one plot and see what happens. It's a short but action-packed adventure that begins slowly but builds rapidly towards the end. I can't give an exact release date, but it will be soon.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1433000/Chronicles_of_cyberpunk__Deep_sleep/

notes.title: Chronicles of cyberpunk - what's next
notes.content:
For a little more than a year I have been actively working on the second game of the trilogy and want to share some news

First of all, I made a small cosmetic update of the first part - I improved the quality of the illustrations and slightly improved the user interface. This game means a lot to me, so I will continue to improve it as much as possible

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31199973/fb655d3616914ac94dd4264aa545b6538481c572.jpg[/img]

The world of the second game, elements of the environment, some animations and basic logic are ready, so it remains to finish the story, make models of people and start programming. At the beginning of the development I was afraid that the second part would be only a link between the first and the third, but now I can say that it will be a full-fledged, eventful adventure with a developed world and a shocking ending

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31199973/3242e6fa65219dc7fe1e9e3c387e2919c21c5610.jpg[/img]

For a long time I learned to model people anew, because for an interesting narration we need well-developed actors so that they can empathize

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31199973/cc384e93b5298bf0652803fa9d9da83e1e6000b1.jpg[/img]

I deleted my website and discussion of the game from the forums, because their design took a lot of time, and now I can devote myself to the development. I plan to do the second part for another 1-2 years

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31199973/bcdc83c2d1b8f9fd18573ed21d5e705c987e418b.jpg[/img]

I understand that in my games it is noticeable that only one person without much experience makes it, but I have a vision of the final result and I believe that in the end something really special can come out

notes.title: Linux and other improvements
notes.content:
Hi! I want to congratulate everyone on the New Year 2018, wish peace, happiness and good =) For me the last year was hard and interesting, as it was necessary to finish the game before the end of the year. Maybe it did not become outstanding, but I honestly tried to do everything as well as I could. It was a unique experience and I will definitely use it in the second part of the game, which is already in development and will be called "Chronicles of cyberpunk: Awakening". Support for the first part also does not stop and here is what's the current update includes:

- Linux-version of the game. It's a pity that I could not release it simultaneously with the Windows version, but I wanted to make sure that everything works without errors. This version of the game contains all the previous updates;

- problems with sound on all scenes have been corrected. The game has a lot of different sounds, but they were all quiet and with a small scope. These areas have been enlarged and now the world of the game is more alive;

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31199973/aae38c6b8c6199586e05645c570e3f7add44a0f5.jpg[/img]

- fixed all the errors that I could find. I still have a list of tasks that I made out of your comments. To perform some of them (such as improving boss battles) I need to learn, but as soon as I can do it, I will definitely do it. I follow your comments and will continue to make corrections =)

As a small bonus, I spread some illustrations from the game:
http://kozyr.org/2016/03/17/liner-paper/
http://kozyr.org/2018/01/03/liner-paper-part-2/

notes.title: Little update
notes.content:
Hi!

It has already been more than 7 days after the release of the game and I want to thank everyone for your support. I just made an update, which includes a new map and fixes of the minor bugs. I constantly follow your feedback and will make corrections if necessary.

P.S. This game is my first big project and it was originally created so that I could learn the basics of game development. The second part of the Chronicles of cyberpunk is in development already and I'll try to take into account all the remarks to make it better both visually and gameplay =)

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31199973/35736b147c2d198d85a3e41a56b059b9fd2fd6a2.gif[/img]

notes.title: Release date announcement - December 7, 2017
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

After almost 3 years of development I'm very excited to announce the release date - December 7, 2017. I just want to add some more strokes to make the game flawless.

I would like to take this opportunity to thank all those who supported me all this time and helped with technical issues. Your support helped the dream came true.

World of the "Chronicles of cyberpunk" is waiting for you =)
